provenance.kind: classical image of census entry 58: Cavity optomechanical element: static radiation-pressure bistability and self-sustained oscillation

phase-locking.obstruction: no oscillation: at 11 values of Ein in [0, 400] every start settles on a stable state or does not become periodic
phase-locking.obstruction_short: no oscillation in the control range

write_points.kind: saddle-node (fold): a state appears or vanishes; written by a pulse past the threshold

unfoldings.kind_along_sweep: supercritical pitchfork: symmetric write; a small bias chooses the state

law.start_of_sweep: the unwritten branch followed back from the write point
law.slow_modes: 2 direction(s) with a rate below 1 sqrt(rate) = 0.141 at the write point relax less than once during the passage: the write takes place in 3 directions, and the law is the 3-dimensional linear stage with the outcome map
law.write_class: not settled at the end of the sweep
law.obstruction_in_nonlinear_stage: the law differs from the full dynamics by up to 0.297 (65.3 errors), and the written states at the end of the sweep do not retain the choice: 13 % of the trajectories change state during a hold of 42.4 time units at the end value of the control. The full dynamics gives the steady-state selection under the bias, an equilibrium write, not the linear-stage law; a retained write needs deeper states at the end of the sweep (a longer sweep, or less noise)
